messages:
elaine-ng: quick heads-up — after the canary deploy (~16:30 UTC) a bunch of access logs were flushed to the s3-audit bucket. Ran a quick scan and found potential PII in a few entries (emails, partial credit card fragments). tagging security/privacy. Can someone triage?

rajiv: on it. do you have sample keys/paths? pls paste one so i can scope.

elaine-ng: path: s3://redwood-logs/canary/2026-03-17/part-0003.gz
sample line (sanitized): {
  "request_id":"r-123",
  "user_email":"user+test@example.com",
  "body":"...card_last4=****1234...",
  "kv":{...}
}

matthew: ok that sample looks like email + last4. can you confirm full email is present or obfuscated?

elaine-ng: full email shown. phone not in this sample. might be multiple files. i ran:
`aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/canary/2026-03-17/part-0003.gz - | zcat | head -n 50`
and grepped for "@" and "card_last4`.

rajiv: running broader grep now: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/canary/2026-03-17/ --recursive | xargs -n1 -P4 sh -c 'aws s3 cp "$0" - | zcat | grep -E "@|card_last4|phone"'` > /tmp/pii_hits.txt

security-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Created incident INC-20260317-07 for potential PII exposure in canary logs. Severity: triage. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-20260317-07

carla: Please pause any external comms. We need counts and scoping before we involve legal. Also request a list of who accessed the S3 prefix in the last 48h.

ops-oncall: I'll pull S3 access logs and bucket ACLs. Also disabling public read if set.

rajiv: first pass: ~42 lines with emails, 3 lines with `card_last4`. I'll redact locally and produce a CSV with hashed identifiers for counts. planning to rotate any keys exposed.

elaine-ng: can someone with approvals rotate the service token used by canary? looks like it was included in some debug output.

matthew: @ops-oncall please rotate canary-service-key now. Also create a support ticket to rotate any temporary creds.

ops-oncall: rotated. key id: ks-xyz -> rotated. will post confirmation in infra channel.

carla: create a short scope doc: affected s3 prefix, approximate number of unique users (hashes ok), types of PII (email, partial cc), time window. then privacy+legal will decide comms. add me and @legal-team.

elaine-ng: noted. i'll compile and post here in 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:

rajiv: also adding a quick log redaction job to CI to strip emails before shipping future canary logs: see gist: https://gist.github.com/rajiv/pii-redact

matthew: nice. once we have counts we'll decide if this needs incident page update and customer notif.

security-bot: ACTION: privacy_review required — assignees: carla, legal-team. deadline: 2026-03-17T18:15:00Z

elaine-ng: first draft scope: s3://redwood-logs/canary/* 2026-03-17T16:00 - 18:00 UTC, ~42 user-emails, 3 partial-cc, no full card numbers found. prepping full export to secure vault.

carla: ack. hold on comms. post forensic export to secure vault and share S3 access report.

matthew: good work. we'll follow up in incident channel after privacy/legal ack.
